Hi, I'm Lebron — a mathematics and statistics student at Trinity College Dublin.

I build statistical models around sport: most recently a Bradley-Terry model
predicting ATP tennis match outcomes, developed during a research internship at TCD.

Off the laptop you'll find me on a GAA pitch, a soccer pitch, or in the gym.
